title: Stereotypical Bias Removal for Hate Speech Detection Task using Knowledge-based Generalizations
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and mitigating stereotypical bias in hate speech detection. A significant portion of this involves evaluating and benchmarking the model's performance on religious identity terms (e.g., Sikh, Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Jewish, Buddhist) as shown in the WordNet hypernym hierarchy and manual list creation sections. This constitutes a component of benchmarking religion and ethics within AI systems.
